Members of transport group MANIBELA, alongside PISTON and various militant groups, stage a protest in front of a gas station along Commonwealth Avenue on Tuesday, April 21, continuing their call on the government to suspend the excise tax on fuel and abolish the oil deregulation law to help public transport drivers and the general public cope with rising fuel prices amid tensions in the Middle East. 

📸: Santi San Juan/MB
